title: The Command Is with God
art: 82:19 closes Al-Infitaar: on that Day a soul will not possess for another soul the power to do a thing, and the command, that Day, is entirely with God. God is not shown in any form; the scene is the closed horizon.
The look of the horizon is imagined.
imagePrompt: The edge of the world: a wide empty plain running out to a hard bright line where the land meets the sky, the sky enormous and empty above it, and one small warm light at the far edge of the plain; ink-wash and parchment texture.

beats.say: And the Quran ends the passage like this: on that Day a soul will not possess for another soul the power to do a thing. No one can help anyone else, and no one can be persuaded to change.
And the command, that Day, is entirely with God. Nothing of that is shown. The scene is the edge of the world, and the light standing at it.

verse.en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
